# Agent Python Tools

## File: huggingface_trl/trl/experimental/cpo/cpo_trainer.py

Prompts

```
['create a CPOTrainer instance to fine-tune a causal language model with contrastive preference optimization', 'build the CPO loss computation supporting sigmoid hinge ipo and simpo loss types with label smoothing', 'tokenize a CPO dataset row by building prompt chosen and rejected sequences with BOS and EOS tokens', 'generate samples from a CPO-trained model during evaluation using beam search with pad token handling', 'compute batch loss metrics including chosen rejected rewards margins and log probabilities for training']
```

Usage

```
{'create_cpo_trainer': 'create a CPOTrainer instance to fine-tune a causal language model with contrastive preference optimization', 'build_cpo_loss': 'build the CPO loss computation supporting sigmoid hinge ipo and simpo loss types with label smoothing', 'tokenize_cpo_dataset': 'tokenize a CPO dataset row by building prompt chosen and rejected sequences with BOS and EOS tokens', 'generate_model_output': 'generate samples from a CPO-trained model during evaluation using beam search with pad token handling', 'compute_batch_metrics': 'compute batch loss metrics including chosen rejected rewards margins and log probabilities for training'}
```
